changes.text: The card is interactive only when `href` or `onclick` is set. Without them it is a static `role="group"` with no tab stop and no "▸ open" cue (it used to be a focusable `role="button"` that did nothing).
`spark` defaults to `[]`, so a card without data shows the sparkline's "No data" state instead of a made-up trend. Pass `spark` explicitly to keep a chart.

The root is always a `<div class="ss-svc">`; an interactive card renders one stretched `<a class="overlay">` (for `href`) or native `<button class="overlay">` (for `onclick`) as a sibling of the content, and gets the `interactive` class. The `role="button"` div and the `<a class="ss-svc">` root are gone.

The control is named by the visible name and status (`aria-labelledby`) and described by host, latency, `meta`, the sparkline and the "last checked" time (`aria-describedby`), instead of an `aria-label` that replaced the content. Links and buttons inside `meta` sit above the overlay, so they are no longer nested inside a link or button.
A card with `href` no longer shows the global animated link underline along its bottom edge; the reset is in the component's own CSS, so it also ships in `vanilla.css`.
The status badge uses the new semantic `Badge` tones: `up` → `positive`, `deg` → `caution`, `down` → `critical`, `maint` → `brand`. The `status` values themselves are unchanged.
The loading badge skeleton reads `--ss-chip-py` instead of the removed `--ss-badge-py` (same values, so it renders the same).
The head and footer gaps read the `--ss-gap-sm` spacing token (was a hardcoded `10px`), so they rescale with the size axis; at `md` the card looks the same.
`href` prop: the card renders as a real `<a>` and navigates natively.
`loading` prop: sets `aria-busy`, shows shimmer skeletons for the name, host, badge and sparkline, and suppresses interaction.
`disabled` prop: an inert card with `aria-disabled`, no tab stop and no click handling.
`updatedAt` prop (`Date` or ISO string): shows a relative "last checked" time in a `<time datetime>` element in the footer.
`meta` snippet for extra metadata rows (version, IP, tags) below the head.
`status="maint"`: a maintenance state with a `--ss-blue` sparkline and a spelled-out "maintenance" badge.
Interactive cards show a `:focus-visible` ring (2px `--ss-primary` outline with a 2px offset); there was no focus indicator before. The accessible name now includes the status ("name, status").
The hover background reads the new theme-aware `--ss-bg-elev-hover` token instead of a hardcoded `#232323`, so hover works in the light theme.
Styles are scoped to the component and no longer ship as global `.ss-svc` rules in `theme.css`. Hand-written `class="ss-svc"` markup styled only by `theme.css` must switch to the component.
`size` prop (`sm` | `md` | `lg`), applied as `data-size-variant` on the root; when unset the card inherits the `componentsSize` config or the global size.
Space activates the card as well as Enter, the card has an accessible name, the badge reads "degraded" instead of "deg", and the "▸" glyph is hidden from assistive tech.
The root class is `ss-svc` (was `hub-svc`) and the tokens it reads are `--ss-*` (were `--hs-*`).
New component: a clickable card for one service that shows its `name`, `host`, a `status` badge (`up`, `deg` or `down`), `latency` and a `spark` sparkline coloured by status.
